```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(scales)
```


```{r}
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
knitr::purl("/home/onyxia/work/UGR/turismo/turismo_districto.qmd", output = tmp, quiet = TRUE)

env <- new.env()
source(tmp, local = env)

distrito_sem <- env$distrito_sem
seccion_sem <- env$seccion_sem
id_dis_sem   <- env$id_dis_sem
id_secc_sem <- env$id_secc_sem
t_distrito <- env$t_distrito


aparttur <- s3read_using(
  FUN       = readr::read_delim,
  delim     = ";",
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c"),
  locale    = readr::locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  object    = "turismo/tur_source_encuesta/2021.csv",
  bucket    = "mperier",
  opts      = list(region = "", base_url = Sys.getenv("AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"))
) %>% select(c("Apartamentos y personal empleado", "Periodo", "Total")) %>% mutate(
    value = readr::parse_number(Total,
              locale = readr::locale(decimal_mark = ",", grouping_mark = ".")),
    date  = make_date(as.integer(substr(Periodo, 1, 4)),
                      as.integer(substr(Periodo, 6, 7)), 1)
  )


```

```{r}
d <- distrito_sem |>
  mutate(
    year  = as.integer(substr(PERIODO, 1, 4)),
    month   = as.integer(substr(PERIODO, 6, 7)),
    date   = make_date(year, month, 1),
    season = case_when(month == 2 ~ "feb",
                       month == 8 ~ "aug",
                       month == 5 ~ "may", 
                       month == 11 ~ "nov"),
    PERIODO = fct_reorder(PERIODO, date)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    vt       = as.numeric(`vivienda turistica`),
    pct_vt   = as.numeric(`Porcentaje vivienda turistica`),
    plz      = as.numeric(plazas),
    plz_p_vt = as.numeric(`plazas por vivienda turistica`)
  )
```

```{r}
vt_nat <- d |>
  group_by(PERIODO, date, year) |>
  summarise(vt = sum(vt, na.rm = TRUE),
            plazas = sum(plz, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_distritos = n(), .groups = "drop")


vt_nat <- vt_nat |>
  mutate(lab = paste0(month.abb[month(date)], "\n", year(date)))

seg <- vt_nat |>
  arrange(date) |>
  mutate(xend = lead(date), yend = lead(vt),
         gap  = date == as.Date("2025-05-01")) |>   # segment May 2025 -> Nov 2025
  filter(!is.na(xend))

ggplot(vt_nat, aes(date, vt)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2025-08-01"),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2025-08-01"), y = 415000,
           label = "Aug 2025\nno data", size = 3, colour = "grey40",
           fontface = "italic", lineheight = .9) +
  geom_segment(data = seg,
               aes(x = date, y = vt, xend = xend, yend = yend, linetype = gap),
               linewidth = .9, colour = "#2C7FB8") +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, colour = "#2C7FB8") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "solid", `TRUE` = "22"),
                        guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(breaks = vt_nat$date,
               labels = vt_nat$lab,
               expand = expansion(mult = .03)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(big.mark = ","),
                     breaks = seq(200000, 450000, by = 50000)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(200000, 420000)) +
  labs(title = "Tourist dwellings in Spain",
       subtitle = "Total over districts",
       x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = "Dashed line: no observation in Aug 2025 (summer peak missing).\nSource: INE, viviendas turísticas") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = .9),
        plot.title.position = "plot")
```
```{r}
lab_vt  <- "Tourist dwellings (INE, platforms)"
lab_apt <- "Tourist apartments (INE, occupancy survey)"

ggplot(vt_nat, aes(date, vt)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2025-08-01"),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2025-08-01"), y = 440000,
           label = "Aug 2025\nno dwellings data", size = 3, colour = "grey40",
           fontface = "italic", lineheight = .9) +
  # tourist apartments (monthly)
  geom_line(data = aparttur, aes(date, value, colour = lab_apt), linewidth = .6) +
  geom_point(data = aparttur, aes(date, value, colour = lab_apt), size = 1) +
  # tourist dwellings
  geom_segment(data = seg,
               aes(x = date, y = vt, xend = xend, yend = yend,
                   linetype = gap, colour = lab_vt),
               linewidth = .9) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = lab_vt), size = 2.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(c("#2C7FB8", "#E6550D"), c(lab_vt, lab_apt)),
                      breaks = c(lab_vt, lab_apt), name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "solid", `TRUE` = "22"),
                        guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(breaks = vt_nat$date,
               labels = vt_nat$lab,
               expand = expansion(mult = .03)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(big.mark = ","),
                     breaks = seq(0, 450000, by = 100000)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 450000)) +
  labs(title = "Tourist accommodation in Spain",
       x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = "Dashed line: no tourist dwellings observation in Aug 2025.\nSource: INE, viviendas turísticas; INE, Encuesta de ocupación en apartamentos turísticos") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = .9),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.justification = "left",
        plot.title.position = "plot")

```

Finalement ce n'est pas si grave la ≠ entre les sources de données car elles ne mesurent pas la même chose, même si c'est un peu curieux que les dynamiques soient différentes, peut-être peut-on y voir une augmentation de l'utilisation des plateformes et de la transition de logements en logements touristiques ce qui est précisément ce qu'on cherche à étudier. En ce sens la différence entre cette base et celle des hôtels / logements touristiques plus classiques peut servir d'indicateur du débordement de l'activité touristique sur le logement ? piste intéressante mais les données des logements "officiels" ne sont qu'au niveau provincial...
